tooltip.venusmod.equipment.portable_life: Prevents environmental exposure in the harsh conditions on Venus.
Works anywhere in your inventory; stops when all four pressure armor pieces are equipped.
After the arrival grace period, uses durability every second while active. Supports Unbreaking and Mending.
tooltip.venusmod.equipment.pressure_helm: Head protection against heat, pressure, and corrosive exposure on Venus.
Each worn piece reduces exposure; a full four-piece set prevents it entirely.
tooltip.venusmod.equipment.pressure_ches: Body protection against heat, pressure, and corrosive exposure on Venus.
Each worn piece reduces exposure; a full four-piece set prevents it entirely.
tooltip.venusmod.equipment.pressure_legg: Leg protection against heat, pressure, and corrosive exposure on Venus.
Each worn piece reduces exposure; a full four-piece set prevents it entirely.
tooltip.venusmod.equipment.pressure_boot: Foot protection against heat, pressure, and corrosive exposure on Venus.
Each worn piece reduces exposure; a full four-piece set prevents it entirely.
Transfers items 10 times faster than a normal hopper.
Place and connect it like a normal hopper.
tooltip.venusmod.machine.atmospheric_con: Condenses Venus's atmosphere into Acid Condensate.
Needs open sky on Venus and at least 16 RPM from Create.
tooltip.venusmod.machine.metal_separator: Turns iron nuggets into nickel (30%) or copper nuggets (35%).
Requires Create rotation. Right-click with iron nuggets to insert.
tooltip.venusmod.machine.blade_repair_st: Automatically repairs SlashBlade durability using Create rotation.
Right-click with a SlashBlade to insert it.
tooltip.venusmod.machine.blade_breaker.d: Dismantles SlashBlades to recover soul fragments and other drops.
tooltip.venusmod.machine.blade_breaker.u: Requires Create rotation. Right-click with a SlashBlade to insert it.
tooltip.venusmod.machine.venus_blade_for: Uses Venus materials to upgrade five SlashBlade abilities.
Right-click to open its GUI. Requires 64+ RPM and a Venus Core.
